name: Bean Hollow SB
description: Bean Hollow State Beach covers a one-mile stretch of San Mateo Coast shoreline south of Pescadero, with two parking lots at Pebble Beach and Bean Hollow Beach connected by a coastal trail.
fullDescription: Bean Hollow State Beach covers a one-mile stretch of San Mateo Coast shoreline south of Pescadero, with two parking lots at Pebble Beach and Bean Hollow Beach connected by a coastal trail.
whatTheyOffer:
- Pebble Beach, known for its ocean-polished stones (collecting is not allowed)
- One-mile Arroyo de los Frijoles Trail with interpretive panels
- Tide pools and wildlife viewing
- Dogs allowed on a 6-foot leash
- No camping, beach fires, or drones; ocean is cold with rip currents and heavy surf
- Open 8 am to sunset; phone (650) 726-8819
howToGetIt:
California State Parks does not list a day-use fee for this park.

**Getting there:** On Highway 1, about 17.5 miles south of Half Moon Bay and 3 miles south of Pescadero.
